buildCommand: set -e; if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then echo "Production build — applying pending Drizzle migrations against ${DATABASE_URL##*@}"; pnpm --filter @tea/db db:migrate > /tmp/migrate.log 2>&1; RC=$?; grep -v 'applying migrations' /tmp/migrate.log | tail -60; if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then echo "Migration failed (exit $RC) — see the lines above."; exit $RC; fi; fi; pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=web
